---
applyTo: "**/*.html"
---

Write HTML for the Zazz kit with the current syntax (0.5 and later). The full rules are in [packages/core/AUTHORING.md](../../packages/core/AUTHORING.md); follow them. Copy a primitive's anatomy from `packages/core/src/primitives/<name>/<name>.html`.

The short version:

- Identity is `data-ui="button"` (space-separated tokens, e.g. `data-ui="card group"`). Where the wrapper would be a plain `<div>`, use the tag form instead (`<ui-card>`, `<ui-tabs>`, `<ui-layout>`); a card on an `<article>` or `<form>` keeps `data-ui="card"`. `class` is yours: a BEM class for styling the kit can't express, never a made-up `data-*` attribute or a non-utility custom property in `style` (`style` holds only utilities and `--ui-*` hooks; custom `data-*` is for script hooks).
- Variants are `data-<identity>-<key>`: `data-button-variant="primary"`. Parts are `data-<identity>-slot="header"`.
- Typography roles are `data-font` with one role per element: `data-font="h3"`, `data-font="sm"`, `data-font="eyebrow"`. Never `data-ui="text-sm"` (retired). An inline link outside prose is `data-ui="link"`.
- Values are style utilities in `style`: `style="--px: 6; --gap: 6"`. Names are Tailwind's (`--justify`, `--items`; `border-radius` is `--radius`), values are CSS (`--justify: space-between`). Exactly one space after the colon. Numbers on spacing, sizing, and radius utilities are scale steps (`--radius: 2.5` is `--radius-md`).
- Breakpoint tiers `--grid-cols--md: 3` on flow, grid, spacing, margin, sizing, typography, and color utilities, plus `--radius`, `--elevation`, `--pointer-events`, and the rings; state tiers `--bg--hover: …` on color, effects, and `--radius`. `--isolation`, `--font-family`, `--font-style`, and `--container-name` take no tiers; `--border-style` takes states only and `--shadow-angle` breakpoints only.
- Shadows: `--elevation: 4` (a height) or `--shadow: var(--shadow-md)` (a token or any box-shadow). There are no size words (`--shadow: md` does nothing). A tier needs its base: `--text: currentColor; --text--hover: …`.
- Use tokens (`var(--space-*)`, `var(--color-<role>)`, `var(--radius-*)`, `var(--font-size-*)`); every `var(--…)` must exist in `packages/core/src/base/_variables.css`.
- Every `<input>`, `<select>`, and `<textarea>` gets a `name` (or, when it must not submit, an `id`); Chrome reports a field with neither.
- Controls have two sizes: the default and `icon` (icon-only). There is no `sm` or `icon-sm` (removed from the kit). A button or toggle inside an input group or password group takes no size; the group sizes it from the field inset (an icon-only one keeps `icon`). Fields never shrink, so a row that mixes fields with buttons or toggles stays at the default size. Never resize one control with hooks or utilities. If the user wants another size, offer to create a size variant (a new `data-button-size` / `data-toggle-size` value, with a field size where fields sit beside it), and ask whether it goes in the global primitives or in the theme overrides (a field size needs the global primitives).
- Grouped options: copy the grouping from the fragment, never a bare `<optgroup label>` or a bold item. Select: each `<optgroup>` keeps `label`, takes `--display: grid; --gap: 1px`, and opens with a `<legend>` carrying the eyebrow utilities from `primitives/select/select.html` (`--p: 2` lines it up with the options). Menu: the same eyebrow `<li>` from `primitives/menu/menu.html`. Combobox and command use their `group-label` slot. Put `<hr data-ui="separator" style="--my: 2" />` between groups, and never pad individual items to fix spacing.
- Never restyle a primitive with a utility it owns. If the primitive declares a `--ui-<identity>-<utility>` hook for the property, or a preset (variant, size…) sets it, don't write the bare utility on it: no `--px`, `--py`, `--h`, `--radius`, `--bg`, `--text`, or `--font-size` on `data-ui="button"`. That flattens its states and cuts the instance off from the theme. Check `packages/core/src/primitives/<name>/<name>.json` (`hooks`, `attributes`). Placement utilities it doesn't hook (margins, `--w`, `--flex`, grid placement, `--order`, breakpoint `--display`) are fine.
- To change an owned property: use a preset if one does it. Otherwise change it only when asked, and ask the user first whether it's for this one instance or for every instance. One instance or region: the hook inline (`style="--ui-button-px: 2"`), which keeps states. Every instance: the hook on `:root` in the theme stylesheet.
- Reference: the docs site at https://zazz.sh (API tables generated from the kit at `/api/`, Markdown twins at `…/index.md`, `https://zazz.sh/llms.txt` for an index).
